## RulesApplied
- Frontend feature architecture is mandatory: features may consume the shared `design-system`/`app` primitives, must preserve module ownership and dependency direction (`FE-BOUNDARY-001`, `ARCH-FE-FREEZE-001`), and must not introduce a parallel/duplicate implementation.
- Reuse existing shared primitives: one blocking-message component, one toast container; no second notification framework, no second copy of the same surface.
- Localization/RTL is mandatory (`SHIPPING-ADMIN-RULES-001` §10–11): no hardcoded two-locale assumptions; fa/en + RTL must be honored by the surface that supplies the copy.
- Operator UX (`TOOBA-UX-001`): plain, actionable Persian-facing copy; no raw technical codes or duplicate messaging for one outcome.
- Acceptance honesty: worker/source PASS ≠ Architect ACCEPT; build/mount success ≠ Visual ACCEPT or functional certification; no compliance claim beyond observed code.

## Analysis
- Role: a thin feature-local adapter that keeps the `AuthoringMessageBox` name/prop contract while delegating the single implementation to the shared design-system `MessageBox` (TB-263 dedup), so authoring and order-operations surfaces render the same primitive.
- Props: fully controlled — required `open`, `title`, `text`, `closeLabel`, `onClose`, optional `testId` passthrough; no internal state, no dismissal path other than the caller's `onClose`.
- Coupling: single import `../../../design-system` barrel; no local duplicated markup, no second message framework, no `app/**` dependency, so it stays inside the feature boundary and respects the freeze.
- RTL/a11y notes: direction, focus management, dialog semantics and hit-target sizing are not visible here — they are inherited from `MessageBox`, so this file cannot itself certify a11y/RTL; copy direction is caller-supplied.
- Localization: no strings or locale logic in this file (good — no hardcoded locale); fa/en correctness depends on callers passing localized `title/text/closeLabel`.
- Risk: pure-proxy wrapper, so behavior drift is bounded to `MessageBox` prop changes; `testId` pass-through preserves test discoverability, but adding required props upstream would surface here first.

## Compliance
No file was edited; the component conforms to the documented dedup/boundary rules by observation, and this analysis makes no Architect/Visual ACCEPT claim.
